parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of rule that was triggered. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all rule types is returned.

- **blacklist**: The IP address blacklist.

- **custom**: A custom rule.

- **antiscan**: A scan protection rule.

- **cc\_system**: An HTTP flood protection rule.

- **region\_block**: The Location Blacklist feature.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
